_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld

goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough. The Four Devas is only possible if Time Attack is enabled. This requires you to have the Expansion Pass.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Exlude locations in Fornis Region - Full
If a region is set to be excluded, they will be attempted in a specified order.
If too many locations would be removed by excluding the region then the region will remain included.
Later regions set to be excluded will still be attempted and may be excluded if they have fewer locations.
